correct: I don't wake up at 7 o'clock.
explanation: Agrega <don't> antes del verbo para formar una oración negativa: <I don't wake up>.

source: She brushes her teeth every morning.
correct: She doesn't brush her teeth every morning.
explanation: Usa <doesn't> + la forma base para tercera persona: <She doesn't brush>.

source: He goes to school by bus.
correct: Does he go to school by bus?
explanation: Usa <Does> + sujeto + forma base para preguntas: <Does he go>.

correct: Do they eat breakfast at 8 am?
explanation: Usa <Do> + sujeto + forma base para preguntas: <Do they eat>.

correct: I walked to the park.
explanation: Agrega <-ed> a los verbos regulares para el pasado simple: <walked>.

source: She drinks coffee in the morning.
correct: She drank coffee in the morning.
explanation: <Drink> es irregular: <drank> en pasado simple.

correct: We don't watch TV after dinner.
explanation: Agrega <don't> antes del verbo: <We don't watch>.

correct: Do you like reading books?
explanation: Usa <Do> + sujeto + forma base: <Do you like>.

correct: He ate lunch at noon.
explanation: <Eat> es irregular: <ate> en pasado simple.

correct: He doesn't play football on Saturdays.
explanation: Usa <doesn't> + forma base: <He doesn't play>.

source: They go to bed at 10 pm.
correct: They went to bed at 10 pm.
explanation: <Go> es irregular: <went> en pasado simple.

source: She takes a shower every day.
correct: Does she take a shower every day?
explanation: Usa <Does> + sujeto + forma base: <Does she take>.

correct: I don't have breakfast at home.
explanation: Agrega <don't> antes del verbo: <I don't have>.

correct: She got up early.
explanation: <Get> es irregular: <got> en pasado simple.

correct: Do we cook dinner together?
explanation: Usa <Do> + sujeto + forma base: <Do we cook>.

source: I read a book before bed.
correct: I read a book before bed.
explanation: <Read> es irregular pero se escribe igual en pasado: <read> (se pronuncia /rɛd/).

correct: They don't do homework after school.
explanation: Agrega <don't> antes del verbo: <They don't do>.

source: He listens to music at night.
correct: Does he listen to music at night?
explanation: Usa <Does> + sujeto + forma base: <Does he listen>.

correct: We had dinner at 7 pm.
explanation: <Have> es irregular: <had> en pasado simple.

source: She rides her bike to work.
correct: She doesn't ride her bike to work.
explanation: Usa <doesn't> + forma base: <She doesn't ride>.
